package.name: safedrl_drone_nav
package.description:
Simulator-neutral deep-reinforcement-learning drone navigation with control-barrier-function enforcement.
A constrained (Lagrangian) PPO policy and a discrete-time CBF safety filter exchange only standard ROS messages (Odometry, LaserScan, Twist), so the same checkpoint runs on the course simulators AirSim (through airsim_ros_pkgs or the AirSim Python API) and MuJoCo (through the bundled MJCF plant). PyBullet is kept as a lightweight offline environment for unit-level mathematical verification, not as the course simulator. The package also ships the reproducible training/evaluation pipeline and the run-trace evidence generator.
